CC:Dan
Hi Zack—
First of all, hugely helpful. Once we powered down first before moving the pot, we were able to get a great delay dialed in.
We have one (hopefully) last issue. The gate opens and closes at the right spots and there is no sign of binding. Appreciate any ideas and thanks!
Tim
